item.title: 2026.10.21-beta
item.description:
## What's new
- Settings got a full visual overhaul: every pane now shares one row and section layout, controls line up across tabs, text fields for rule names and regexes get more room, and locked or inactive settings share one dimmed look. - New Support section in Settings, with a "Copy support summary" action that puts the version, build and device ID on the clipboard, plus links to Discord, email and the docs. - The first-launch assistant is easier to follow: steps show plain-language statuses, and the Screen Recording permission now leads with what it is for, window previews in Overview, the switcher and tab hovers, and notes that captures stay in memory and are never saved or sent. - Deactivating a license key now asks for confirmation first.
## Fixes
- License activation failures are no longer silent: an invalid, refunded or device-limited key now shows an error message instead of appearing to do nothing. - Several settings displayed defaults the app never used, including the tab gap, the overview thumbnail toggle and the focus ring corner radius; the shown values now match the real ones. - Firefox windows relocated to avoid the mouse across displays no longer land mid-screen. - Moves issued over IPC now place windows correctly. - In the Binds tab, clicking a workspace group's title now expands it; previously only the small caret worked. - Pressing Record on a keybind no longer shifts the shortcut field sideways.
Also includes internal improvements.

item.title: 2026.10.19-beta
item.description:
## What's new
- Keybind and gesture settings now flag duplicate bindings. A banner and captions on the affected rows name the conflicts, and a conflict you introduce while editing blocks saving until it's resolved. Conflicts already present in the config file stay advisory. - The Pro pane now links to the website for current plans and pricing instead of embedding prices in the app, and purchase links are enabled again. - The free tier now tiles up to 8 windows. The cap applies only to newly tiled windows, so a trial ending mid-layout never evicts what's already laid out; windows beyond it float in place, the status bar shows how many slots are in use, and upgrading re-tiles everything the cap floated. - Deactivate now works from lapsed installs too, so a Mac whose coverage window has passed can still free its license slot for another machine. A failed deactivate now shows an error instead of failing silently.
## Fixes
- Powering a monitor off and back on no longer collapses the layout. Reconnects used to arrive staggered, and the first one-screen event would cram everything onto the surviving display, scrambling column order and stranding windows; the layout now waits for the full display set to return and comes back unchanged. - Windows placed in a named workspace by a rule stay there while displays reconnect, instead of being dropped onto a numbered workspace. - Switching windows no longer snaps focus back to a parked native tab group a second later. - Fixed a positioning bug that could park a window with only its title bar visible. - Parked native tab groups no longer show blank thumbnails, and clicking one brings the right tab forward. - Native tab groups move as a single unit between workspaces, and closing a tab now returns focus to the group instead of an arbitrary window. - When a trial expires, windows parked in named workspaces now move to Workspace 1 instead of becoming unreachable, and windows floated past the cap while parked off-screen are brought back on screen. - Also includes internal improvements.

item.title: 2026.10.06-beta
item.description:
```markdown ## What's new
- The free tier now only has a single workspace per display. When a trial ends, windows from the other workspaces are folded into Workspace 1, and the trial-expired dialog explains what changed on screen. - Layouts now adapt when the menu bar's auto-hide setting changes or when SketchyBar starts, quits, or changes its inset, so tiling no longer keeps reserving space that is not there. - Window rules and named workspaces can be duplicated in Settings. Saving is prevented while a duplicate is still identical to its original, and a banner explains what needs to be resolved first. - In the keybinds panel, workspace groups now carry the Pro lock badge on the free tier, with a caption explaining that the badge marks Pro features and that your bindings are kept. - Workspace keybindings (focus workspace, move column to workspace, move window to workspace) are indicated as Pro features. Bindings you have already configured are preserved and reactivate when you upgrade. - Settings sidebar sections are sorted alphabetically within their groups.
## Fixes
- Fixed a crash when clicking the Override button on a window rule's width field. - Text in Settings no longer renders upside down when the window is opened from the trial-expired dialog's "Enter License Key" button. - Tab indicators no longer stay in their old spot after a display is reconnected or reconfigured; they follow the window again. - Also includes internal improvements to build and release tooling. ```
